summary: Streaming chat requests time out at 120s for Pinecone Labs (eu-west)
description:
Issue summary: Customer using streaming chat endpoint reports responses cut off at ~120 seconds for long generations. Client receives EOF; they retry and sometimes succeed.

Impact: Affects long-running customer support agent flows; 'partial answers' and retries increasing cost.

Environment: Dedicated cluster behind ALB (eu-west).

Observed: ALB idle timeout 120s. Streaming chunks are not emitted frequently enough during long tool execution.

Ask: Can Redwood send keepalive chunks / heartbeat events during tool execution and/or update recommended ALB settings?
comments: Naomi Feldman (CSM): Customer says 'streaming starts then pauses for 2+ minutes when tool call runs' -> ALB closes.
Hiro Tanaka (Platform): Confirmed ALB idle_timeout=120s on their dedicated ingress. Current behavior: during tool execution we don't emit stream chunks.
Hiro Tanaka: Workaround: raise idle timeout to 300s and enable TCP keepalive. Shared doc snippet with customer.
Elliot Price (Runtime): Longer-term: add optional heartbeat event 'event: ping' every 15s when generation is blocked on tool. Tracking in internal issue INT-812.
Resolution: Customer updated ALB idle timeout to 300s; confirmed no more mid-stream disconnects. Ticket closed.
